segs.text: Fame feels like success. It might be destroying you.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: Two wolves free among sheep are no more destructive to them than a man's desire for wealth and honor is to his religion.

quote.text: Two wolves free among sheep are no more destructive to them than a man's desire for wealth and honor is to his religion.

segs.text: Chase likes, and you start living for people instead of Allah.
Allah says: That eternal Home in the Hereafter We reserve only for those who seek neither tyranny nor corruption on the earth.

quote.text: That (eternal) Home in the Hereafter We reserve (only) for those who seek neither tyranny nor corruption on the earth.

segs.text: Do the work. Stay hidden. Let Allah raise you.
